The resulting binary is installed into the package directory with appropriate permissions. All operations are confined to the build directory and follow standard packaging practices.

There are no signs of malicious behavior such as unauthorized network requests, obfuscated code, unexpected file operations, or execution of downloaded payloads. The package depends only on `mpv` and `yt-dlp`, which are legitimate multimedia tools consistent with a YouTube Music streaming client. The use of Vim keybinds is mentioned in the description, aligning with the application's stated purpose.
